description: The system shall allow SAT users to create new spots in a location.
A name can be assigned to each spot.
The floor is assigned automatically or new ones can be created.
The created spot is displayed automatically.
The system shall allow SAT users to delete spots from a location.
A spot cannot be deleted if it has assigned assets.
The system shall allow SAT users to create assets assigned to a spot.
All asset and asset type attributes must be addable to the asset.
The system shall allow SAT users to delete assets from a spot.
An asset can only be deleted if it is not assigned to an intervention.
The system shall allow SAT users to modify the information of an asset.
The system shall allow SAT users to enter the 3D map ID for a location.
A new ID cannot be entered once one is already assigned.
The system shall allow any user to view assets distributed in a location.
The system shall allow any user to view assets distributed in a location in 3D map format.
The system shall allow any user to view all assets they have access to in a table.
The system shall allow SAT users to create a new intervention.
The system shall allow SAT users to delete an intervention.
An intervention can only be deleted if it is not finalized.
The system shall allow a technician to perform and complete an intervention.
The system shall allow any user to view the history of interventions performed.
The interface must follow the style and colors of the Waapiti platform.
The interface must be switchable to Catalan, Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese.
The system must be easy to learn for technical users.
The system must respond quickly to user actions.
The system responds to any user action in less than five seconds.
The system must always be available, except during scheduled updates.
The system must support an unlimited number of simultaneous connections.
The system must adapt to screen changes, for example from a desktop computer to a mobile phone.
The project functionalities must be accessible only to authorized users.
Confidential user information must be protected and privacy must be guaranteed.
